lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖਮ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sookham moorat naam nira(n)jan kaaiaa kaa aakaar ||
lines.translation: But to the subtle image of the Immaculate Name, they apply the form of a body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਦੇਣੈ ਕੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sateeaa man sa(n)tokh upajai denai kai veechaar ||
lines.translation: In the minds of the virtuous, contentment is produced, thinking about their giving.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਗੂਣਾ ਸੋਭ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: de de ma(n)gahi sahasaa goonaa sobh kare sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: They give and give, but ask a thousand-fold more, and hope that the world will honor them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੋਰਾ ਜਾਰਾ ਤੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ਖਾਰਾਬਾ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: choraa jaaraa tai kooRiaaraa khaaraabaa vekaar ||
lines.translation: The thieves, adulterers, perjurers, evil-doers and sinners

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਹੋਦਾ ਖਾਇ ਚਲਹਿ ਐਥਾਊ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਕਾਈ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik hodaa khaai chalahi aithaaoo tinaa bh kaaee kaar ||
lines.translation: - after using up what good karma they had, they depart; have they done any good deeds here at all?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਜੀਆ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਲੋਆ ਆਕਾਰਾ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal jeeaa pureeaa loaa aakaaraa aakaar ||
lines.translation: There are beings and creatures in the water and on the land, in the worlds and universes, form upon form.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਜਿ ਆਖਹਿ ਸੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi j aakhahi s too(n)hai jaanahi tinaa bh teree saar ||
lines.translation: Whatever they say, You know; You care for them all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਾਲਾਹਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagataa bhukh saalaahan sach naam aadhaar ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the hunger of the devotees is to praise You; the True Name is their only support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਪਾ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d rahahi din raatee gunava(n)tiaa paa chhaar ||1||
lines.translation: They live in eternal bliss, day and night; they are the dust of the feet of the virtuous. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੀ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ਕੀ ਪੇੜੈ ਪਈ ਕੁਮੑਿਆਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: mitee musalamaan kee peRai paee kumhiaar ||
lines.translation: The clay of the Muslim's grave becomes clay for the potter's wheel.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘੜਿ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਇਟਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਲਦੀ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghaR bhaa(n)de itaa keeaa jaladee kare pukaar ||
lines.translation: Pots and bricks are fashioned from it, and it cries out as it burns.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਜਲਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਝੜਿ ਝੜਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਅੰਗਿਆਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal jal rovai bapuRee jhaR jhaR pavahi a(n)giaar ||
lines.translation: The poor clay burns, burns and weeps, as the fiery coals fall upon it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jin karatai kaaran keeaa so jaanai karataar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Creator created the creation; the Creator Lord alone knows. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur kinai na paaio bin satigur kinai na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, no one has obtained the Lord; without the True Guru, no one has obtained the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur vich aap rakhion kar paragat aakh sunaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He has placed Himself within the True Guru; revealing Himself, He declares this openly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur miliai sadaa mukat hai jin vichahu mohu chukaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Meeting the True Guru, eternal liberation is obtained; He has banished attachment from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਤਮੁ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: utam ehu beechaar hai jin sache siu chit laaiaa ||
lines.translation: This is the highest thought, that one's consciousness is attached to the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jagajeevan daataa paaiaa ||6||
lines.translation: Thus the Lord of the World, the Great Giver is obtained. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vich aaiaa hau vich gaiaa ||
lines.translation: In ego they come, and in ego they go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੁਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vich ja(n)miaa hau vich muaa ||
lines.translation: In ego they are born, and in ego they die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vich ditaa hau vich laiaa ||
lines.translation: In ego they give, and in ego they take.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਟਿਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vich khatiaa hau vich gaiaa ||
lines.translation: In ego they earn, and in ego they lose.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vich sachiaar kooRiaar ||
lines.translation: In ego they become truthful or false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vich paap pu(n)n veechaar ||
lines.translation: In ego they reflect on virtue and sin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vich narak surag avataar ||
lines.translation: In ego they go to heaven or hell.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਸੈ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vich hasai hau vich rovai ||
lines.translation: In ego they laugh, and in ego they weep.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਰੀਐ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vich bhareeai hau vich dhovai ||
lines.translation: In ego they become dirty, and in ego they are washed clean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vich jaatee jinasee khovai ||
lines.translation: In ego they lose social status and class.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vich moorakh hau vich siaanaa ||
lines.translation: In ego they are ignorant, and in ego they are wise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mokh mukat kee saar na jaanaa ||
lines.translation: They do not know the value of salvation and liberation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vich maaiaa hau vich chhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: In ego they love Maya, and in ego they are kept in darkness by it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai kar kar ja(n)t upaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Living in ego, mortal beings are created.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai boojhai taa dar soojhai ||
lines.translation: When one understands ego, then the Lord's gate is known.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan vihoonaa kath kath loojhai ||
lines.translation: Without spiritual wisdom, they babble and argue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak hukamee likheeai lekh ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, by the Lord's Command, destiny is recorded.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਤੇਹਾ ਵੇਖੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jehaa vekhahi tehaa vekh ||1||
lines.translation: As the Lord sees us, so are we seen. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai ehaa jaat hai haumai karam kamaahi ||
lines.translation: This is the nature of ego, that people perform their actions in ego.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਈ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai eee ba(n)dhanaa phir phir jonee paahi ||
lines.translation: This is the bondage of ego, that time and time again, they are reborn.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਇਹ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai kithahu oopajai kit sa(n)jam ih jaai ||
lines.translation: Where does ego come from? How can it be removed?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਹੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai eho hukam hai paiai kirat phiraahi ||
lines.translation: This ego exists by the Lord's Order; people wander according to their past actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੀਰਘ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਦਾਰੂ ਭੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai deeragh rog hai daaroo bhee is maahi ||
lines.translation: Ego is a chronic disease, but it contains its own cure as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kirapaa kare je aapanee taa gur kaa sabad kamaahi ||
lines.translation: If the Lord grants His Grace, one acts according to the Teachings of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨਹੁ ਇਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kahai sunahu janahu it sa(n)jam dukh jaahi ||2||
lines.translation: Nanak says, listen, people: in this way, troubles depart. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਈਁ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sev keetee sa(n)tokheeee(n) jinhee sacho sach dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who serve are content. They meditate on the Truest of the True.
